subject: Co-Engineering Kickoff: Vector Storage + Redwood runtime scope
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Brooks <ebrooks@pinecone.io>, Marina Korsakov <marina@weaviate.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-Engineering Kickoff: Vector Storage + Redwood runtime scope

Hi Ethan, Marina —

Thanks again for the quick sync at the conference last week. Per our conversation, we think there is a good opportunity to run a short co-engineering engagement to:

- Validate runtime-to-vector-store integration patterns (prefetching, cache eviction, prefix reuse)
- Define a minimal compatibility test-suite (index schema, scoring, metadata passthrough)
- Prototype a small production flow (1M vectors, typical query QPS and tail-latency targets)

Proposed outcomes (2-week pilot):
1) Working adapter + sample config for Redwood Dedicated and Redwood Private
2) Quantified perf numbers (p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens-per-second, cost delta)
3) Joint playbook for customers (runbooks, recommended knobs)

Agenda for kickoff call (30–45m):
- Quick intros and success metrics (5m)
- Current infra and indexing constraints (8m)
- Integration options (direct JDBC/HTTP, vector-store SDK, hybrid cache) (12m)
- Acceptance criteria + next steps (10m)

Attached: redwood_coeng_brief.pdf (one-pager with sample workloads).

Can you share availability for a kickoff Wednesday or Thursday this week (I put times in PT below)?

- Wed 2027-03-31 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 2027-04-01 08:30–09:15 PT

If you prefer, we can do a shorter technical-only sync with engineering leads — Camila and Dev are CC'd and will drive the benchmarks.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood_coeng_brief.pdf (type: application/pdf, 1 page)

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the clear brief — excited to collaborate. Wed 10:00 PT works for me.

Quick technical notes for the agenda:
- We can validate both upsert-time metadata passthrough and hybrid nearest-neighbor fallthrough logic.
- For the 1M vector pilot, our typical index shard layout will be fine; we should confirm vector dimensionality and quantization plan (FP16 vs 8-bit PQ).
- I dropped a short doc with schema suggestions: pinecone_schema_notes.docx (attached).

Also tagging our solutions engineer: 
- Jonas Patel (internal) will join; I can loop him once call time is locked.

Links: 
- Proposed HubSpot link for joint pilot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8721/record/D-7821

See you Wednesday — Ethan

Ethan Brooks

ebrooks@pinecone.io

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 14:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Co-Engineering Kickoff: Vector Storage + Redwood runtime scope

Hannah / team —

Thanks, Ethan — Wed 10:00 PT is good on my calendar as well. A couple of internal notes before the call: 

- Dev and I will bring a lightweight benchmark harness (node load generator + sample prompt set) and a template for acceptance criteria.
- Please make sure we get the exact vector dims and any quantization/codec you'd like us to use; mismatched codecs are the most common source of noise.
- We should also lock an SLA baseline for this pilot so product can estimate support coverage if we find regressions. Suggest p95 token-latency <= 120ms for LLM embeddings lookup path during the pilot.

On the call I'll propose the following deliverable checklist:
* Adapter PR merged to our integration repo (draft)
* Perf report with raw logs and dashboards (Grafana link)
* Runbook with recommended knobs and a small customer-facing FAQ

Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
